notes: EDGE CASE: 'now available at $X' with NO prior-price cue and no 'reduced/was' language. Genuinely ambiguous between a fresh ACTIVE_SALE_LISTING and a PRICE_DROP. Honest answer leans ACTIVE_SALE_LISTING (no repricing signal), but classifier confusion is exactly what we measure -> lower confidence floor. We grade the address/price/beds (unambiguous) but keep confidence low.
